examples.note: You can now upload video files directly to Shopify and showcase them in Collage, Tab Collage, Video, and Video Hero sections. An automatic video looping option has also been added.
Mixed media per device Added the option on selected sections to show a video on desktop and an image on mobile, giving you more control over how content adapts across screen sizes.
Added an option to hide/show the slider title block and to add slider title, content and button link and added an option to add a video in each block in the collection list section.
Added a mobile full width toggle to Image with text, Apps, Collapsible rows, Custom content, Featured video, Grid with overlay, Image comparison and Scrolling text on image sections
Added a new behavior option to the Upsell and Complementary Products block. Upsell and Complementary Products can now be added to the cart separately or with the main product item.
Size selector now appears on "Recently Viewed" slider — Previously the size selector was missing from product cards inside the Recently Viewed slider even when enabled. Now fixed.
Based on user feedback, a dynamic Recently Viewed Products section was added, allowing you to add this feature anywhere on your site. Prior, this was only available on the cart page
Added a Recently Viewed Products section, enabling customers to browse products they've previously viewed — with the same layout and settings as the Product Recommendations section.
We added schema locale translations in 13 different languages (including English, German, French, Italian and Spanish), so you can now use those languages within the theme editor.
We added schema locale translations in 13 different languages (including English, German, French, Italian and Spanish), so you can now use those languages within the theme editor.
Made the mini cart drawer fully translatable, including "Your Cart," "View Cart," "Checkout," and "Order Note." Resolved placeholder translation issues in the order notes section.
Added support for more languages: the theme is now pre-translated to 28 languages (for the storefront only). This means you can now add multi-language to your store much faster.
Added trustbadge settings to the general theme settings, so merchants can enable a customizable trustbadge on the product page, featured product section, cart drawer and cart page.
Related Products in Add-to-Cart Notification: The add-to-cart notification can now display related products, and clicking 'View Cart' opens the cart drawer (if enabled) on mobile.
You can now apply discount codes directly from the cart drawer or cart page. This setting is turned off by default, but you can turn on the new "Allow discount application" setting.
Made the mini cart drawer fully translatable, including "Your Cart," "View Cart," "Checkout," and "Order Note." Resolved placeholder translation issues in the order notes section.
[Quick buy] Refreshed dialog UI. It now follows its own color scheme setting instead of the drawer and popover scheme, and the View full details link stays above the product form.
Added B2B volume pricing: shows a quantity price-break table and a live "at $/each" price near the quantity selector on the product page, quick view, and featured product sections
Added an option to choose whether available variants are automatically selected by default on product cards and in Product Information, Featured Product, and Quick View sections.
Included multipliers for the "Add to Cart" button. Settings for this feature are provided in the sections for product templates, featured products, quick view, and featured products.
Added the set of 'Account, cart and search' settings in Theme settings > Typography to adjust the font, case, and letter spacing for the corresponding text labels in the header
Typography settings for the Announcement bar - gives you more control over the look of your announcement messages, announcement menu, and currency and language drop-down menus
Important: All Announcement bar related section settings - color scheme and typography - are now found under the Announcement Bar section. Reinput of desired values is needed.
Rich Text section: Added a Blockquote block designed specifically for stylish block quotes. A number of visual design settings are included, allowing for creative typography.
Filter names matched via the "Variant option for swatches" setting now respect the "Show color swatches" filter toggle, consistent with names matched by the built-in language list.
Gray border for color swatches with very light colors to enhance visibility against light backgrounds. This can be controlled under Theme Settings > Color swatches > Enhance visibility.
Fixed an issue in Product Cards where images were not changing correctly on the product page in combined listings when variants were disabled and color swatches were enabled.
We added color swatches that allow online store to show products in specific colors. You can enable / disable this option on the product page and in collection product list.
Added heading size setting in multiple sections like featured collection, featured product, collapsible content, newsletter, featured blog, collage with text, collection list etc.
Email signup popup: We added the expiration time setting that allows you to adjust the time to show the popup again after users tick "Do not show popup again" and close the popup.
Footer Enhancements: Added Divider and Gallery blocks, updated Newsletter button icon options, and optimized mobile layout positioning for Copyright, Payment Icons, and Social Links.
Customizable modal windows A new flexible modal framework that allows merchants to create configurable popups such as newsletter signups, various promotions, or exit-intent messages.
Fix issue with customer login link opening a new tab Fix incorrect height of 'natural' variant image swatches Improve variant picker accessibility when using dropdown selector style
Boosted Accessibility: We've made significant enhancements to the theme's code to improve accessibility, ensuring a better experience for all users, including those with disabilities.
User Experience Enhancements: Complex or cluttered areas of the theme have been simplified to improve accessibility, reduce setup time, and create a smoother editing experience.
Fixed product images appearing blank on collection pages, product pages, and product cards for visitors who turn on the reduced-motion (reduce animations) accessibility setting on their device.
Countdown timer section - create urgency around sales events or promotions with an animated timer that counts down in seconds, minutes, hours and days from a specific date and time.
Added the Subheading block on the Countdown timer, Image banner, Image with text, Image with text overlay, Layered images with text, Map, Reveal banner, Rich text, and Video hero sections.
Introduced the option to set the exact time along the date for a countdown timer, providing greater precision control. You can also toggle the display of weeks and seconds.
Countdown Timer: Added an optional countdown timer block to the Rich Text section. This can be used as a countdown to special events such as a product launch or sale event.
Typography settings for the Announcement bar - gives you more control over the look of your announcement messages, announcement menu, and currency and language drop-down menus
We added a setting to change the font style of the Announcement bar, Checklist, Collection list, Featured shops, Media with text, Multicolor cards, Testimonials, and Rich text sections.
Fixed an edge case where menu would not display properly if the announcement bar is positioned after the header, and that both announcement bars and headers are configured to be sticky.
Important: All Announcement bar related section settings - color scheme and typography - are now found under the Announcement Bar section. Reinput of desired values is needed.
Important: Added a new mega-menu type — Hover mega menu. You can preview it in the Vortex preset, and enable it by adding the “Hover mega-menu” block in the Header section.
The mobile hamburger menu now displays the mega menu elements assigned to each navigation link on desktop, giving mobile shoppers access to the full menu layout.
Two header mega-menu blocks — Sidebar Mega Menu (level-2 links beside level-3 image cards) and Menu Highlight (per-menu style, colour and nav badge, 9 styles).

Two new mega menu blocks for the Header section: Mega menu (Cards) for a promotion-card-only layout, and Mega menu (Tabs) for nested links organized in hoverable vertical tabs with optional promotion cards
The sticky add-to-cart bar now matches Header colors by default instead of the product page background. Use the Background and Text settings under Sticky add to cart to override.
The product quantity rules "min" and "increment" were not working correctly in the main productpage section, productpage sticky add to cart section and featured product section
B2B quantity pricing: volume price breaks table, live unit price near quantity, price range note, quantity rules, sticky bar quantity sync, and cart quantity rule limits
[Sticky Add to Cart Enhanced] The sticky add-to-cart section has been redesigned for improved usability, ensuring a smoother and more engaging shopping experience.
Main and Featured and product sections: Product Details block: Add support for variant metafields. Just prefix the metafield path with 'variant.', e.g. "Width: variant.custom.width"
26 new icons — drop, leaf, flask, sparkle, sprout and friends — available to Guarantees, product accordion tabs, the header's icon badges and the highlights metafield's icon slot.
To accommodate the use of metafields and metaobjects, sections were updated to ensure the primary content, i.e. content blocks, will ensure the section is displayed or not loaded
Main and Featured product sections: Product Details block: Add support for variant metafields. Just prefix the metafield path with 'variant.', e.g. "Width: variant.custom.width"
Important: Added new main navigation block options for richer header layouts, including buttons, rich text, social media icons, localization selectors, and icon-with-text content.
Changed the language and currency selector visibility settings in the header and the announcement bar to choose whether to show them on desktop, mobile, or both device types
Kept translucent Interactive Island headers and their open Menu, Search, Cart, Account, and localization panels visually continuous without changing saved glass settings.
To simplify mobile display, we moved the configurations for showing languages and currency selector from a separated block to the "Mobile navigation" section settings.

points.name: Image focal points and art direction

examples.note: 'Image position' options throughout the theme has been removed in place of 'Focal Points'. Some images, like blogs, will still have the option since Focal Points are not available
Image aspect ratio setting for cart drawer recommendations — You can now choose between square (1:1) and portrait (3:4) image ratios for recommended products in the cart drawer.
Media Layout Improvements: Media positioning and aspect ratio settings have been enhanced to provide better control over imagery, ensuring consistency and responsiveness across devices.
Removed all image position and mobile image position settings and implemented Shopify's image focal points feature instead. The following sections/pages are affected: 404 page
[Quick buy] Refreshed dialog UI. It now follows its own color scheme setting instead of the drawer and popover scheme, and the View full details link stays above the product form.
Added a new Scrolling text banner section: a hero with animated moving text with color scheme control and optional images, so you can put a message or promotion front and center.
Important: Since version 7.0.0, we updated to support Color schemes, and we provided a tool to support migrating your theme to the latest version, please check our tutorial here.
New "Color scheme" settings - 2 schemes can be defined in the main theme settings and several sections have the option to select one of these color schemes or set custom colors
Fixed an issue in Product Cards where images were not changing correctly on the product page in combined listings when variants were disabled and color swatches were enabled.
Product variations — Introduced product variations functionality, allowing for a combined listing of separate product variations for a more streamlined shopping experience.
When using combined listings (for Shopify Plus only), the theme will now show secondary images associated to the combined product on product cards when using swatches.
Products can now be combined into a single listing using Shopify Combined Listings, making it easier for buyers to browse related variants or styles in one place.
Contact form section - start a conversation or increase engagement with your customers by enabling them to input their details and send a message directly to you.
Contact form section: added 2 new block types: Social media icons and custom text to help merchants show social media icons and custom text on the right sidebar.
We changed the Featured Product section's "Tab content" block by removing the "show contact form" option because there is already a "Tab contact form" block.

Contact form: A wider range of form fields can now be inserted into the form to capture additional information. The new fields include order number, dropdown list, radio list, checkbox and multi-checkbox.
Important: Added new main navigation block options for richer header layouts, including buttons, rich text, social media icons, localization selectors, and icon-with-text content.
Contact form section: added 2 new block types: Social media icons and custom text to help merchants show social media icons and custom text on the right sidebar.
We've added more layout and content options to the Password page - you can now choose the image position, button style and include social media icons/links.
Changed the social media icons visibility in the announcement bar to choose whether to show them on desktop, mobile, or both device types
Predictive search resource types can now be selected in The Search & Discovery App instead of the theme settings. Predictive search results now support the "queries" resource type
Extended Search exclusion configuration to allow hiding products within excluded collections in predictive search, search suggestions, product recommendations, and cart upsell.
Predictive search now integrates with the Shopify Search & Discovery app. Choose to display any combination of queries, products, collections, pages and blog posts.
Predictive search can now include results from product descriptions, SKUs, barcodes, and tags. Check out the new settings in Theme Settings > Search to enable this.
26 new icons — drop, leaf, flask, sparkle, sprout and friends — available to Guarantees, product accordion tabs, the header's icon badges and the highlights metafield's icon slot.
Added heading size setting in multiple sections like featured collection, featured product, collapsible content, newsletter, featured blog, collage with text, collection list etc.
Added section visibility setting in multiple sections like featured collection, featured product, collapsible content, newsletter, featured blog, image with text, collection list etc.
Added a new setting to show the animated gradient heading text in multiple sections like before/after, featured blogs, collapsible content, collection carousel and collection list etc.
Added app block support to the Main Article and Main Collection Product Grid sections so merchants can drop in review widgets, related products, or social proof without editing liquid.
Section group support: re-order sections even inside the header, or add sections easily in the footer group to have global sections visible on every pages, without having to duplicate the content.
Added Shopify Theme Blocks support — a new block-based architecture that works across sections, giving users full control over layout and content composition
Removed the ratings block on the main product, and featured product sections. This can be replaced by app blocks from your review app provider of choice.
Added more display options to the Product page Inventory status block, including the ability to show inventory count and an additional description for different inventory statuses.
Improved inventory status display to show stock quantities, low-stock thresholds, and product availability more consistently across product pages, featured products, and Quick View.
Improved inventory status display to show stock quantities, low-stock thresholds, and product availability more consistently across product pages, featured products, and Quick View.
Product page: Inventory status now follows variant availability when stock is not tracked, while the "Show inventory count" setting continues to show exact quantities for tracked variants.

points.name: Core Web Vitals and load performance

examples.note: Preloaders for images to ensure seamless and visually appealing loading. To enable, go to 'Theme settings → Animation → Images' and select an effect in the 'Lazy loading' dropdown.
Important: Performance — Optimized loading speed, prevented render-blocking resources, improved lazy loading for hover images, optimized badge loops, and streamlined head variables
Added new "Preload theme fonts" setting — turn it off when the top of your page is an image or video, so the hero media loads first. Enabled by default to keep current behavior.
Product card main media won't be lazy-loaded for the three first product cards, if the section that hold them is at the top of the page. This approach allows to improve a bit the LCP.
Fix issue with customer login link opening a new tab Fix incorrect height of 'natural' variant image swatches Improve variant picker accessibility when using dropdown selector style
[Quick buy] Product cards can now open a bulk order table (all variants with quantity steppers) straight from the listing, chosen per section (standard variant picker or bulk order).
Centralized the "is this a color option?" check into a single snippet so behavior stays consistent across product cards, variant pickers, filters, and active-facet pills.
Product variant selector settings were changed for a better user experience, and allow combining new color swatches with the other product options in a more intuitive way
Add "Keep LTR content direction in RTL layout" setting to Slideshow, Image gallery with text, and Image banner section to keep the content direction when users view the website in RTL layout.
RTL (Right to Left) page direction/layout is now automatically applied if an RTL language is active. This can be turned off in Theme Settings > Layout, if preferred.
Flawless now supports right-to-left languages, letting you build a fully localized store for Arabic, Hebrew, and other RTL-language audiences.
RTL support: the theme now supports out of the box RTL languages (such as Arabic or Hebrew), without the need for any extra customizations.
Important: Added support for empty filter values. To return to the previous theme settings, go to Settings > Filters > Empty values in the Search & Discovery App and choose 'Hide'
Predictive search resource types can now be selected in The Search & Discovery App instead of the theme settings. Predictive search results now support the "queries" resource type
Added support for the new "Empty values" setting in the Search & Discovery app. This new setting allows you to choose how filter values with no matching products are shown in your store.
Added support for the new "Empty values" setting in the Search & Discovery app. This new setting allows you to choose how filter values with no matching products are shown in your store.
Changed the name and position of the 'Enable transparent header' setting: it is now called 'Visibility' and can be found among the 'Transparent header' set of settings in the header
Header: Added the option of a glass blur backdrop filter effect. This new setting works in combination with a semi-transparent header to give a glassy blur effect to elements behind the header.

Fixed an issue where the transparent header would not revert back to transparent all the time if the header is configured to NOT be sticky (sticky header - the default - do not experience such issue).
Setting to enable transparent header on collection pages. Controlled via a toggle in the header section's Transparent header settings (default: off).
Added a new setting in Global Settings → Badges: "New badge show days". When the badge type is set to Dynamic, the "New" badge will be displayed for the specified number of days.
Important: changed the number of custom badges in the 'product badges' theme settings; this change will result in your current product badges settings being set back to default
Added more sale badge display options. You can now choose between the default text, savings percentage, or amount saved. This applies to product cards and the product page.
Fixed an issue where the sale badge on product cards displayed incorrect prices by only considering the visible variant. It now calculates across all product variants.
The free shipping bar feature will now exclude non-physical items (such as gift cards) for the free shipping calculation, so that it is consistent with how Shopify calculates it.
New theme setting: Country list in the shipping calculator. This setting allows merchants to display all countries or specified countries of the current market in the shipping calculator.
Added the estimate shipping calculator for the cart drawer that allows for checking estimate shipping rates for your location; it also automatically sets the location for logged-in customers
Added a free shipping progress bar with configurable threshold, custom messaging, gradient styling, and milestone indicators (supported in both cart drawer and cart page)
You can now apply discount codes directly from the cart drawer or cart page. This setting is turned off by default, but you can turn on the new "Allow discount application" setting.

We've improved the Password page. It now includes the option of an email sign-up form, additional layout options, and the option to hide the password link if preferred.

The password page now includes the ability to add an image background to further customize the look of your store. By default, the background is composed of an illustration that includes your theme’s accent color.
Removed admin link in the password template, because shop url links are not accessible from the Password page without login credentials.
Fixed an issue where the Subscribe button on the Password page remained disabled when Terms and Conditions were enabled.

B2B quantity pricing: volume price breaks table, live unit price near quantity, price range note, quantity rules, sticky bar quantity sync, and cart quantity rule limits
Quantity rules tied to product variants (minimum, maximum, increments) are now displayed on the product page, along with notifications if items are already in the cart.
Added a new setting to show the animated gradient heading text in multiple sections like before/after, featured blogs, collapsible content, collection carousel and collection list etc.
New sections with add-section presets: hero, statement, story, mosaic, marquee, before/after, shop the look, timeline, proof, FAQ, gallery, image divider and product showcase.
'Image Comparison' Section. Allows you to compare images side-by-side, perfect for showcasing before-and-after scenarios or highlighting differences.

Before/after section: show a before/after section to help your customers to see the benefit of your product. Upload a different image on mobile or desktop to provide the best experience to every of your customers.
Add support for "gift card recipients": on gift card products, you can now allow your customers to leave a message and an email to whom the gift card is sent.

Added a Product structured data toggle to Theme Settings. Use this setting if you have a third-party app that handles structured data. Found in Theme Settings > Advanced.
Add more information to the product rich snippets. Add a new setting to read product rating data from Shopify review apps such as Loox, Okendo, and Stamped.
We fixed an issue where the Age Verification feature did not continue on to the site after clicking the "Enter Site" button. This issue only occured when working in the Theme Editor.
New section: Age Verifier. We have added an optional age verifier for use on stores with age-restricted content or products. This can be added/activated within the header group.

Added a new option to the "Age verifier" section to choose between a birth date or a button confirmation. This message gives merchants more flexibility on how they want to control access to their stores.
We added the age verifier feature, which requires age verification to restrict access to your store content from those who are not appropriately-aged.
Add support for "Follow on Shop" button: if your store have Shop Pay enabled, you can now display a "Follow on Shop" button in your footer.

Important: Fix "Load More" dying after filters re-render the grid when the first-loaded view had a single page — pagination.js now loads unconditionally for load-more/infinite modes
Important: Load more and infinite scroll pagination options for product grid — configurable per collection via section settings (Paginated, Load more, Infinite scroll).
Added infinite scroll to collection pages, search page, blog pages and collection list page. This will need to be enabled in Theme settings > Design > Pagination.
Optimized product card images with responsive size hints, allowing browsers to load more appropriately sized images and reduce bandwidth on smaller screens.
We added a quick order list section, which adds a table of all product variants that can be easily added to the cart within one simple form using a single add to cart button.
[Quick order list] New product page section with a bulk order table. Shoppers set quantities for every variant at once and add them all to the cart in one step, with live line totals and subtotal.
We added a quick order list section to the product page allowing for adding multiple variants to the cart with one add to cart button.
We introduced a new Quick order list section to the product template. This allows you to optimize your product pages for bulk buying.

Account Pages: Replaced standard login, registration, order, and address pages with the Shopify Account Component. This enhances security and enables quick login via Shop, Facebook and Google.

We added support for the new customer account component to streamline checkout and personalization, including passwordless sign-in, automatic sign-in when recognized by Shop, and popular social sign-in providers.

A new "Show date" setting (disabled by default) has been added on blog posts section and main blog post page, which allows to show the article publication date on blog post cards.
Added section visibility setting in multiple sections like featured collection, featured product, collapsible content, newsletter, featured blog, image with text, collection list etc.

Additional service block on the product page. This allows adding related additional services to the cart along with the main product, such as a warranty, shipping protection, service subscription, etc.
On the productpage and in the Featured product section, the selling plan option is now selected by default when it's required and the only available option.

Changed the notifications (toasts) component with accessibility fixes, cleaner cookie-consent handling via Shopify.customerPrivacy, and more reliable display when triggered from URL parameters.
Added Cookie banner feature to allow customers to consent to tracking of non-essential cookies. This allows customers to consent to relevant, region-specific, tracking laws such as GDPR and CCPA
Privacy banner: comply with GDPR and CCPA laws by using a privacy banner that integrates with the native cookies and data collection feature of Shopify.
The cookie banner/popup section has been removed. You can configure Shopify's cookie banner instead in the admin under Customer privacy settings.

Products featured in the mega-menu will now show unit price (for products that are configured with unit pricing), in order to comply with European regulations.
Localized unit prices Updated unit price rendering to use Shopify’s unit_price_with_measurement filter, allowing unit prices to be automatically localized.

Added support for size guide drawer that can also be used as size chart, for main and featured product section and also for quick view drawer.
Added a new "Size Chart" popup modal feature to the Variant Picker block in the Product Information section on the Product page.
Fixed an issue where the Size Chart modal remained open on the product page even when Quickviewwas disabled in global settings.
New Shopify storefront web components: account navigation menu with customizable quick links, new sign-in methods such as passwordless sign-in, automatic sign-in and social sign-in.
All disconnectedCallback methods added to section custom elements — cleans up document/window event listeners, GSAP timelines, Flickity instances, and IntersectionObservers.
Featured Collection: Pagination width adjusted and all custom elements and tabset component removed from the placeholder
Refactored to use Custom Elements better JS structure, section lifecycle handling, and JS event management
